item.author: invalid@example.com (Mach 307)
item.dc:creator: Mach 307
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR / Solution

For 2021+ S550 Mustangs with the wired rear buckle sensors, this allows the rear buckle/receptacle assemblies to be completely removed when installing a rear seat delete instead of leaving the wired buckles plugged in to prevent DTCs.

Using FORScan, change the following values:

IPC 720-02-02:
xxx4 xxxx → xxx0 xxxx

RCM 737-02-01:
xxxx xxxx 7xxx → xxxx xxxx 1xxx

Change only those identified values, not the entire As-Built lines.
